name: Cloudgate Academy
description: A branded learning academy with courses, enrolments, assessments, certificates and Cloudgate payments.
features: Public searchable course catalogue and responsive learner portal
Course authoring, ordered modules and lessons, preview lessons and publication validation
Free and paid enrolments with verified Cloudgate Wallet checkout and refunds
Lesson progress, quizzes with server-side scoring, attempt limits and certificates
Instructor assignments, live training sessions, attendance and learner discussions
Cloudgate media, shared SMTP, user management, logs, custom branding and About
Premium responsive design with six colour presets and individual theme controls

summary: Course owners are responsible for their learning content and permissions.
Payments and refunds are processed through Cloudgate Wallet.
Certificates record completion of academy content and do not imply external accreditation.

compliance.label: Content rights confirmed
compliance.text: I have the rights to distribute the course content and media.

compliance.label: Sandbox learning journey verified
compliance.text: I have verified enrolment, payments, lesson access, assessments, certificates and email delivery in hosted sandbox.
